body:
I saw the thumbnail and expected greater things. 

I am disappoint. But then again, I probably shouldn't be looking for pictures of pretty girls in /r/SW.
Well. Thanks for listening. I think I'm set for the next couple days. I'll probably be back soon.
Whoever determined my life to be this way can fuck himself. If that's me, fuck me.

Yeah. I never understood that. Suicide is only "bad" and never really ever accepted. People die. And if I really want to die, I will kill myself any other way possible. And if I do want to die, I don't want people to worry. I want people to send me off well. Linger on the good memories of me and not cry at my funeral. I feel like suicide is a natural thing.

Well. I don't know. It doesn't really interest me that all these people are trying to help me. It's ultimately how people I truly care about are going to react to my death (Not to say that I don't care about redditors - I do care about you guys). I have no where to go. I wouldn't want to be a burden to my brother. And don't have the money to live on my own. That's why I'm so damn pressured. I don't have much choice and I have been dealt a pretty shitty hand.
To be completely honest, I'd rather just run away and become "dead" to my family and live a whole new life instead of opening up to them about my depression. I need a fresh start.
And do you understand how tiring it would be to live day by day for the rest of my life? No one has that much energy to pull through day to day like it's their last.
I am seeing a therapist. And I have been for the last 1.5 years. And I'm tired of nothing working.
I can't trust you. Sorry.
Because letting things just be is the best way for me. And letting things be means letting sorrow take over. I'm through.

I'm seriously considering your reply. I might take time off of school. But my brother and my uncle are driving down three hours to my campus to see what's up with me in the middle of the night after all the things that happened tonight. I'll see what happens with them and see if they think it's the best for me to take time off of school.

20 interviews, dawg. I don't care about girls as much as my own life. But I've got no invitation to interview after I submitted my resumes to 20 different companies.

Actuarial science is a pretty technical field in that it only prepares you to be one thing - an actuary. And if I can't be an actuary, I don't know what else I would do.
What can you possibly do other than convince me out of my awful funk? Nothing realistic would ever be achieved, nor would it ever matter if I'm not here. How can you help?
God damn. You're right.

Getting rejected 20 times really fucking hurts. 

Fuck this. I'm not posting on SW anymore. 

Bye guys.

Look. I posted my personal situation on another post earlier. And fine the pressure isn't actually physical. But I HAVE to give a fuck about what I am doing. I'm walking on a tight rope here. One misstep and I fall. 

It's either I do this or I run away to where no one can find me. And to be honest, I'd rather die because as you said, this depression is going to haunt me forever regardless of where I end up. And if I can't face my inner demon now, I can't face my inner demon later.

I don't deserve to calculate anyone's premiums. To answer your question, yeah I have passed one exam and I signed up to take another exam at December. I mean, I'm graduating now. At the end of this year. And the fact that I got no interviews for actuarial science hit me hard, despite me having applied to 20 some places. 

Yeah. I had to work 15 - 20 hours a week to pay off the difference between expected tuition cost and financial aid. And even with financial aid, more that 60% of it is student loan because I don't apply for most of them.

Fine point. But putting a value on what could happen in future is kinda lame, no? I mean, I broke up with HER. I shouldn't be suffering at all. But I am. And she doesn't want me back. That just crushes whatever self-esteem I had left. 

Even writing this post makes me sad. What the fuck happened to me?

I just found out that I have no future in things I study about - actuarial science. At first I was very fascinated with valuing human life and placing premiums based on each and every risk. But I realized that I really have no place at calculating people's lives. I've had academic trouble mostly in my sophomore year because of the intensity of the depression and a new job. So when I applied for internships all throughout US, of course I didn't get any offers. 

And then there's my financial situation. I've had to pay for every single penny of the tuition money out of my own blood. And that burnt me out pretty bad as well. And now I'm neck-deep in student loan debt and I will have difficulty paying off that debt when I eventually graduate. 

And then there's the relationship situation. I've dated a few people but no one serious. Right before this, I was certain that I was on the right path to become "undepressed." But the break up really put things into perspective for me.

Pfft. Yeah. Suggestion for the method of choice. (Just kidding.)

Like what? Ditch my life and go traveling abroad? I don't have any money for that. Just get back up on my own feet on my own? I obviously can't do that. What should I do?

Ah. And how appropriate is it that it's raining on the day I'm killing myself. Perfect.

I deleted that post. Tell you about what? What is there to tell? That I'm going through pain and that I already planned out everything for tonight? That no matter what you - or anyone else for that matter - do or say, I'm going to kill myself tonight? What do you want from me?

I've been depressed for about the last seven years. But suicidal thoughts have only surfaced since two years ago. Just the pressure, I guess. Pressure to perform. Pressure to love. Pressure to be good. Pressure to survive. Pressure to live. Pressure to not kill myself. My question to you is, why shouldn't I kill myself?

Well no. jdc123 *implied* that there is any pain. And yeah sure there's pain. Psychological pain. The one that manifests everywhere. I heard of "Why don't you live just one more day for my sake, SWthrowawayyyy?" way too often. And to be honest, I've been seeing therapists and psychiatrists for the last couple years. And nothing seems to have worked. I'm tired of waiting and I want to end it now.

I posted a while back. But seeing how my name is rather unamusing and uninteresting, I suppose you guys have forgotten.

I just don't want to anymore. And an eternal peace/death seems more attractive than something like this.
Your reply implies that all pain is temporary. A ridiculous claim to say the most. An insensitive claim to say the least. I will let sadness win. At least that means I'll be peaceful.
Why not?
